item.title: HorrorCraft Add-On 1.4: DWELLERS, BIOMES and more
item.creator: HorizonBlocks
item.description:
Add HORROR to any world! This Add-On fills your game with SCARY MOBS, creepy DWELLERS and horror BIOMES! 

+ dwellers 
+ new boss fight 
+ scary mobs 
+ horror biomes
+ newly generated structures 
+ insane villagers and golems 
+ VFX and fog effects 
+ new ore 
+ many new items, weapons, armor and blocks 
+ creepy sounds

faqEntries.heading: How do I obtain the HorrorCraft Guide Book?
faqEntries.content: Combine one Book and one Soul Piece at a Crafting Table. Place the Guide Book on a block to open it.

faqEntries.heading: Where can I find HorrorCraft Dwellers?
faqEntries.content:
Explore the Dead Forest, Cursed Meadows, Black Forest, Widow Cave, and their structures. Some creatures also require nighttime, weather, or a Red Moon.

Hint: There are also summon some scared variants of vanilla mobs in vanilla biomes.

faqEntries.heading: When does the Red Moon happen?
faqEntries.content: The Red Moon normally rises every eighth night. It changes the environment, increases hostile activity, and allows mutated creatures to appear.

faqEntries.heading: How do I obtain special weapons and armor?
faqEntries.content: Collect resources from custom biomes, structures, ores, and defeated creatures. Use the Guide Book to view the available equipment and crafting recipes.

faqEntries.heading: How do I summon the Banned Wither?
faqEntries.content:
Collect its three unique skulls, find the rare battle arena, and place them on the unfinished Wither body at the arena’s center. 

Hint: You will find the Banned Wither Skulls in the following structures:
- Forgotten Villages (Cursed Meadows) 
- Haunted Towers (Black Forest) 
- Infested Labyrinths (Dead Forest)

faqEntries.heading: Can the HorrorCraft settings be changed?
faqEntries.content: Yes. World operators can adjust options including Red Moon spawn intensity, Red Moon hunger, water slowness, scary mob spawning, and visual settings.

howToEntries.heading: Explore horror biomes
howToEntries.content: Search for the Dead Forest, Cursed Meadows, Black Forest, and Widow Cave. Each biome has a unique atmosphere, creatures, resources, and structures. Some enemies only appear in their associated biome or structure.

howToEntries.heading: Search for newly generated structures
howToEntries.content:
Explore Infested Hives, the Infested Labyrinths, Forgotten Villages, Graveyards, Faceless Pillager Camps, Haunted Towers, Cursed Houses, Infested Houses, Cursed Trees, and Mother Nests. Prepare strong equipment before entering these dangerous locations. 

Find "Banned Wither Skulls" in the following structure types: 
- Forgotten Villages (Cursed Meadows) 
- Haunted Towers (Black Forest) 
- Infested Labyrinths (Dead Forest)

howToEntries.heading: Defeat the Banned Wither
howToEntries.content: Find three unique Banned Wither Skulls hidden inside major biome structures. Locate the rare Overworld battle arena and place the skulls on its unfinished Wither body. Defeat the summoned boss to receive exclusive rewards.

howToEntries.heading: Survive the Red Moon
howToEntries.content:
A Red Moon rises every eighth night. The sky turns red, hostile activity increases, and mutated creatures can appear. Prepare a shelter before nightfall or hunt the creatures to collect their special drops.

Hint: You cannot skip this night by sleeping!
